selection_method: Four deliberately small comparison entries were chosen to span neutral and +1 charge, calculated lipophilicity below and around PRL, and four to six rotatable bonds while remaining in a nearby molecular-weight range. They are geometric/scoring background only, not assay-supported nonbinders or calibrated decoys.

entries.reason: neutral flexible diaryl tertiary amine; similar rotor count and calculated lipophilicity
+1 state of the same flexible diaryl scaffold, separating charge-state from topology in this model
+1 flexible amino ester with lower calculated lipophilicity and molecular weight
neutral two-ring ester with fewer rotatable bonds and no basic nitrogen

stereochemistry: All four selected graphs are achiral as written; no unspecified stereocenter is introduced.
warning: No entry is labeled inactive. No ACC2 assay evidence was used or implied. This tiny set cannot calibrate enrichment or binding probability.
